# Behavioral Health Business

> > Behavioral Health Business (BHB) is the leading trade publication covering the business of mental health, substance use disorder treatment, and autism services.

BHB provides news, analysis, and insights for executives, investors, and operators in the behavioral health industry, covering topics including Medicaid policy, medication-assisted treatment (MAT), facility development, mergers and acquisitions, and regulatory changes affecting providers across the United States.

## Key Topics

- Medicaid policy and reimbursement
- Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT)
- Substance use disorder treatment
- Opioid use disorder (OUD)
- Autism services and ABA therapy
- Mental health parity enforcement
- Telehealth and virtual care
- Integrated care models
- Facility development and real estate
- Private equity and M&A activity
- CMS policy and Medicare coverage
- Outpatient treatment programs
- Serious mental illness (SMI)
- Provider-payer contracting
- Trauma-informed care

## Policy and Regulatory Developments

- [From Medicaid Changes to Parity Enforcement: What a Biden Administration Means for Behavioral Health](https://bhbusiness.com/2020/11/10/from-medicaid-changes-to-parity-enforcement-what-a-biden-administration-means-for-behavioral-health): Biden administration's potential impact on Medicaid and parity enforcement
- [CMS Expands Medicare Coverage for Treatment of Opioid Use Disorder](https://bhbusiness.com/2019/11/13/cms-expands-telehealth-coverage-for-treatment-of-opioid-use-disorder): CMS expands Medicare coverage for OUD treatment including telehealth
- [Acadia CMO, Behavioral Stakeholders: Payment Reform Necessary to Improve SMI Treatment](https://bhbusiness.com/2020/10/12/acadia-cmo-behavioral-stakeholders-payment-reform-necessary-to-improve-smi-treatment): Acadia CMO, stakeholders call for payment reform to improve SMI treatment
- [$1.8B Autism Funding Bill to Expand Access to Services](https://bhbusiness.com/2019/10/23/1-8b-autism-funding-bill-to-expand-access-to-services): Autism CARES Act reauthorized with $1.8B for service expansion
- [White House Launches Website to Simplify Search for Addiction Treatment Facilities](https://bhbusiness.com/2019/10/31/white-house-launches-website-to-simplify-search-for-addiction-treatment-facilities): White House launches FindTreatment.gov for addiction treatment search
